# Frozen Phase 2 compatibility sources

Seven exact source-only inputs acquired for the Phase 2 Linux/CUDA contract.
`reports/phase2/manifest.json` records their original document IDs, exact titles,
provenance and UTF-8/Graph Contract fingerprints. Passage/full-paper pairs keep
identical literal paper IDs and distinct case IDs. Runner transport uses case IDs
so both can occur in one invocation without changing scientific document identity.

Do not normalize, replace or expand these sources after observing results.
These fixtures are not scientific gold and contain no cached predictions.
Large actual runtime observations remain under ignored `.cache/phase2/`.
See `reports/phase2/README.md` for the blocked prerequisite and resume boundary.
